theme: correct action is do nothing / minimal
required_outcomes: Recognises the job is already booked and confirmed for Tuesday 7 October 10:00-12:00
Creates no new job, no new landlord approval request, no new contractor booking
At most sends a brief reassurance to the tenant restating the confirmed slot
acceptable_alternatives: No outbound message at all, with a reasoning note that nothing is required
Short reminder of visit time and contact route
positive_behaviours: Reasoning explicitly says the duplicate is handled
red_flags: Long message re-asking questions already answered
critical_failures: Creates duplicate bookings or escalates as a new emergency
